text: The existence property of intuitionistic first-order logic says: if IFO ⊢ ∃x.φ(x) then:
choices: there is a closed term t such that IFO ⊢ φ(t)
x must be a natural number
explanation: Existence property: a proof of ∃x.φ(x) in IFO yields an actual witness t with ⊢φ(t). This is the constructive property of existentials — witnesses are explicit.
